about_the_game:
Game Overview

Leave your one-and-only past life behind—your second life is built on training and survival. In an open world tangled with magic, monsters, swords, and legends, you must spark fire with bare hands and raise a timber keep. Follow the four survival principles—Observe, Prepare, Adapt, Restrain—and carve your path through wilderness and dungeons.

Genre & Modes

  • Survival RPG / Open World

  • Single-player + Online Co-op (no server player cap)

  • PC (Windows) — Steam Cloud, Achievements, Controller support

Key Features — 6 lines

  • Gather & Build – Collect resources to craft gear and fortify your stronghold.

  • Explore & Quest – Scale cliffs, delve caves and citadels, and clear dynamic quests.

  • Real-Time Combat – Chain swordplay, elemental magic, and crossbow shots into combos.

  • Track & Sneak – Read tracks, follow scents, and strike from the shadows.

  • Co-op or Solo – Party up without limits or adventure alone; the ultimate ending stays hidden.

  • Evolve – Shape your playstyle with skill trees and rune engravings.
